notes.defaultNames: Template names in a source kind that load as the default, highest first. additional_chat_templates/file.jinja takes the vocab key chat_template_file, the same key as chat_template.jinja, so it replaces chat_template.jinja; default.jinja is read after it and wins (tokenization_utils_base.py L1645, L1679, L1797-1808). Absent means ["default"].
notes.ignoredWhenPresent: A source kind the runtime never reads while any source of the listed kinds exists in the model.
notes.names: The only template names the runtime reads from a source kind. Absent means every name.
notes.builtinWhenHint: When the model sets this hint, the runtime renders with a built-in template and loads none of the model's own.
notes.cStrings: Keys and values are read as C strings: a key ends at its first NUL, the first matching key wins, and a value ends at its first NUL.
notes.fallback: When the default template is absent or its value is one of whenDefaultIs, the runtime loads this named template instead.
notes.failsWhenPresent: The runtime raises while loading, and so uses no template, when every kind in one of the listed sets is present: a legacy chat_template.json beside additional_chat_templates/ raises ValueError (processing_utils.py L1403-1409).
